# Paint protection and body armor mods

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

Spray coating onto a clean surface in thin, independent coats to protect paint. [t593]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. Spray the coating onto a clean surface in thin, independent coats.
2. Allow each coat to semi-dry before applying subsequent layers.

_Procedure reported by [t593]._

## Tools

- [Partial] Sprayer or can [t593]

## Tips & gotchas

- Apply tape immediately after spraying and peel it off while the coating is still wet for sharp lines, rather than waiting until dry. [t593]
- [Partial] Ensure the entire surface receives each coat before adding more layers. [t593]

## Common mistakes

- Peeling masking tape too late (after drying), which results in crumbs and thin lines instead of clean edges. [t593]
- [Partial] Spraying only a section at a time rather than covering the whole area for even coverage. [t593]
